description: Partial demolition of the Billard Hall and erection of a three storey side extension to public house. Creation of four x one- bed and two x two bed self contained flats on upper floors of public house and extension. Erection of a terrace of four x two storey two- bed houses to the rear of premises with associated landscaping and 5 parking spaces.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the flats and houses hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - A scheme of phasing of development shall be submitted to and agreed by the Local Planning Authority before development commences and the development shall be implemented in accordance with that scheme unless otherwise agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - Separate access to the residential accommodation on the upper floors of the premises shall be available to residents at all times.
Condition : 6 - The public house use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times [11pm-8am].
Condition : 7 - No amplified or other music shall be played in the public house premises outside the following times [8am-11pm].
Condition : 8 - No deliveries shall be taken at or despatched from the public house outside the hours of 8am-7pm nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 9 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am-6pm on Mondays to Friday and 8am to 1pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 10 - The windows formed in the 1st floor northern and western elevation of the terrace of houses shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 11 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) 1995 (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order) no enlargement of the houses or erection of  any additional structures/buildings within the curtilage of each house shall be carried out.

Condition : 12 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no additional windows/dormer windows shall be constructed.
Condition : 13 - The waste and recycled materials storage arrangements shown on the approved drawings shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 14 - Construction of the flats above the public house shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound between the flats and the public house has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 15 - 15.	No development shall take place until details shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority for a scheme of acoustic insulation to ensure the maximum noise level to be permitted within dwellings with windows shut and any other necessary means of ventilation provided shall not exceed the "good" limits contained in BS8233:1999 these being LAeq,16hour = 30 dB in living rooms, and a night(07:00 - 23:00) LAeq,8hour = 30 dB and LAFmax = 45 dB in bedrooms, and a night LAeq,1hour = 45 dB in Kitchens, Bathrooms and Utility Rooms ".  The details shall be carried out as approved.

Condition : 16 - 16.	No development shall take place until details shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority for a scheme of suitable ventilation and hermetically sealed (when closed) glazing for windows and doors to  rooms of the dwellings on the Chiswick High Road facade.  The details shall be carried out as approved.
Reason: To provide a reasonable standard of living conditions for future occupiers
 Suitable ventilation systems will need to:
o Take air from a clean location or treat the air and remove pollutants 
o Designed to minimise energy usage
o Be sufficient to prevent summer overheating
o Have robust arrangements for maintenance
o Be designed to ensure satisfactory internal acoustics and prevent loss of amenity to neighbouring uses
o Incorporate heat recovery

Condition : 17 - 17.	No development shall take place until details have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, for a scheme of reducing carbon emissions from the total energy needs (heat, cooling and power) of the development by at least 10%, but aiming for 20% if technically possible, by the on-site generation of renewable energy. The details shall be carried out as approved

Condition : 18 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for control of fumes and odours including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.

Condition : 19 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for the ventilation of the premises of an appropriate outlet level, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard or dilution expected has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 20 - Within 6 months of the date when the first residential unit hereby permitted is occupied,  the land shown on the permitted ground floor plan drawing no 177/GA/71E as  communal amenity area and soft landscaping shall be laid out in accordance with that plan as amenity land.

Condition : 21 - No house shall be occupied until space has been laid out within the site in accordance with plan ref 177/GA/71E for 5 cars to be parked and for the loading and unloading of vehicles and for vehicles to turn so that they may enter and leave the site in forward gear.
Condition : 22 - No flats shall be occupied until space has been laid out within the site in accordance with plan 177/GA/71E for 6 bicycles to be parked.

Condition : 23 - The parking, loading, turning  and cycle parking spaces shown on drawing No. 177/GA/71E shall be constructed and available for use before first occupation of any part of the development and such spaces shall not be used for any other purposes.

Condition : 24 - 24.	No development shall take place until the applicant has secured the implementation of a programme of archaeological work, in accordance with a written scheme of investigation which has been submitted by the applicant and approved by the Local Planning Authority

Condition : 25 - Before commencement of development details of measures for the harvesting of rainwater, the minimisation of water run-off from the building and the conservation and reuse as appropriate of other water supplies in the flats, houses and public house shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The scheme shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
